summary: Genius Group Ltd files a Form 6-K to disclose supplemental information regarding its April 16, 2026 $8 million registered direct offering and its concurrent acquisition of a note convertible into a 9.9% equity interest in Jewel Financial Limited (Jewel Bank). The offering involved 2,297,297 ordinary shares at $0.37 per share and pre-funded warrants. The acquisition used $5.5 million plus 15,000,000 restricted ordinary shares (deemed price $0.40/share). American Ventures LLC was lead investor and is also a member of the acquiring entity. This is not a standalone special situation but a disclosure of completed transactions with related-party involvement to watch for regulatory and transparency issues.
